svg.title: A loop of wire, a clock edge, and the wall behind them
svg.desc: A whiteboard sketch building memory in four steps - two inverters wired in a loop that holds a bit, the same loop plus a clock making a D flip-flop with the rising edge marked as the only instant anything changes, a multiplexer added so a load line chooses between keeping and replacing, and sixteen of those making a register with eight registers plus an address making a RAM - beside a log-scaled bar chart of the memory hierarchy from a one-nanosecond L1 hit to a hundred-microsecond NVMe read, and an eight-by-eight grid showing one cache line fully used when sweeping along a row and almost entirely wasted when jumping down a column.
svg.text: A loop of wire, a clock edge, and the wall behind them
